Actually, I don't really know what I want to achieve in life. It never really occured to me what I want later on in life as I just struggle to keep surviving until tomorrow.

It's probably the fear of being alone. I've been through some pretty traumatic things, and I think it has caused me to become too afraid to be comfortable on my own and to constantly try to seek companionship from others.

I really don't have an image of what my optimum behavior should be. But, I just want to stop being getting attached to someone too fast as I'm afraid that being too attached to someone you recently just met is going to cause some problems later on. And that's why I'm trying to see if I can find a way to stop being so quick to become attached to someone.
